breaking_changes.BC_description: The `onFID()` function has been removed from the library. This function was previously used to measure and report the First Input Delay (FID) metric.
breaking_changes.Adaptation_method: Remove usage of `onFID()`. Consider using other Web Vitals metrics like INP (Interaction to Next Paint) instead, which is the recommended replacement for FID.
breaking_changes.RequireInfo: The documentation doesn't provide specific code examples for how to replace onFID() calls. Additional information about recommended alternatives (such as specific code examples showing migration from onFID to alternative metrics) would be helpful.

breaking_changes.BC_description: Browser support policy has changed to 'Baseline Widely Available'. This may affect compatibility with older browsers that were previously supported.
breaking_changes.Adaptation_method: If your site needs to support legacy browsers, load the web-vitals library in a separate script file from your main application bundles, either via `<script type="module">` and `import` statements or via your bundler's code splitting feature. If including web-vitals in your main bundle, configure your bundler to transpile the web-vitals code along with the rest of your application JavaScript.

breaking_changes.BC_description: The order of classes in attribution selectors has been changed to reduce cardinality. This affects how element selectors are formatted in attribution data.
breaking_changes.Adaptation_method: Update any code that relies on the specific order of classes in attribution selectors. The classes now appear in a sorted order which could change existing selector strings.
breaking_changes.RequireInfo: The documentation lacks details about the exact nature of the change to class ordering in attribution selectors. Examples showing the before and after format of these selectors would be helpful, as well as clarification on which specific attribution properties or methods are affected.
